sources.title: Burkina Faso: current US citizen entry and visa-suspension guidance
sources.officialityEvidence: Current destination page on the US Department of State travel.state.gov domain, directly opened and read including entry requirements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: As of Dec 30, 2025, the Government of Burkina Faso suspended visas to Americans with limited exceptions.

unresolved.reason: Current US guidance still confirms suspended visa issuance with limited exceptions, consistent with the signed reciprocal-visa communiqué. Neither establishes treatment of already-valid visas, the scope of exceptions, or an ordinary visitor entry prohibition. Generic embassy eVisa links do not establish a functioning US-national route. Keep unknown; do not substitute entry_restricted or visa_required.
